installing (or updating) VitaDock++ from this usb stick
=======================================================

the pi still needs the internet for this (it downloads gstreamer, mpv and a
few other bits), it just saves typing the curl line.

1. plug the stick into the pi and log in with a keyboard.
   if the dock's already running, press ctrl+alt+f2 to get a login.

2. pi os lite doesn't open usb sticks by itself, so mount it:

     sudo mount /dev/sda1 /mnt

   (if that doesn't work, run  lsblk  and use the name it shows, usually sda1)

3. run the installer:

     bash /mnt/VitaDock++/install.sh

   if it's already installed this just updates it and keeps your settings.

4. let it finish, then restart the pi (sudo reboot) so the boot animation
   and the new tv settings kick in. you can take the stick out after.

after this, updates come from github: menu > system > check for updates.
